classes.name: ArticlesOfAssociation
classes.description: The company’s constitutional document containing the object and other provisions, amended by shareholder resolutions.

classes.name: AuditCommittee
classes.description: An audit committee referenced in corporate governance annexes.

classes.name: BoardOfDirectors
classes.description: The board of directors that determines corporate actions (e.g., dividend distribution and proposed amendments) and updates drafts for resolutions.

classes.name: CEO
classes.description: Chief executive officer role responsible for certifying information in the amendment.

classes.name: CompetentAuthority
classes.description: A regulatory body competent to approve or receive filings under applicable securities regulations (e.g., AMF).

classes.name: ConsolidatedFinancialStatements
classes.description: Financial statements prepared on a consolidated basis for the group.

classes.name: CorporateCustomer
classes.description: A business client referenced as benefiting from counterparty risk guarantees for long-term electricity supplies.

classes.name: CorporateGovernanceReport
classes.description: A report section within the universal registration document describing corporate governance information.

classes.name: CorporateObject
classes.description: The company’s object/mission as defined in the articles of association, including proposed updates to clarify activities.

classes.name: CounterpartyRisk
classes.description: The risk borne by a business client that is targeted by the company’s counterparty risk guarantees.

classes.name: DeputyCEO
classes.description: Deputy chief executive officer role responsible for certifying information in the amendment.

classes.name: Director
classes.description: A member of the board of directors, including directors representing regions or government and those appointed or coopted.

classes.name: DividendDistribution
classes.description: The policy and process for distributing dividends, including advance payments and remaining dividends.

classes.name: FinancialStatements
classes.description: Company financial statements including balance sheet, income statement, and appendix.

classes.name: FinancialYear
classes.description: A defined accounting period referenced for profits, financial statements, and dividend distribution.

classes.name: GeneralManagement
classes.description: General management referenced in the corporate governance annexes and governance structure.

classes.name: GeneralMeeting
classes.description: A shareholders meeting (ordinary or extraordinary) that approves reports, financial statements, and resolutions.

subclasses.name: ExtraordinaryGeneralMeeting
subclasses.description: A type of general meeting with quorum and majority rules for extraordinary matters such as amending the articles of association.

subclasses.name: OrdinaryGeneralMeeting
subclasses.description: A type of general meeting with quorum and majority rules for ordinary business items such as approving financial statements and dividend distribution.

classes.name: GeneralReserve
classes.description: General reserves constituted by shareholders referenced as a main source relied upon for guarantees.

classes.name: Guarantee
classes.description: A financial guarantee activity referenced as part of the company object, including guarantees for repayment and counterparty risk.

classes.name: GuaranteeFund
classes.description: A fund provided or established to back or finance guarantees, referenced in the company object description.

classes.name: GuaranteeFundImplementation
classes.description: The implementation of a guarantee fund entrusted by government to encourage long-term renewable electricity contracts.

classes.name: InvestorRelationsWebsite
classes.description: A website section used to make the amendment available to the general public.

classes.name: LegalAndArbitrationProceedings
classes.description: Legal and arbitration proceedings referenced as part of additional information.

classes.name: LongTermElectricitySupply
classes.description: Long-term electricity supply arrangements using renewable energies referenced in the updated company object.

classes.name: MajorContract
classes.description: A significant contract referenced in the list of documents and major contracts.

classes.name: NonFinancialPerformanceStatement
classes.description: A statement section covering non-financial performance, including training metrics for AML/CFT and anti-corruption.

subclasses.name: EmployeesTrainingStatement
subclasses.description: A non-financial performance subtopic focusing on employee training in AML/CFT and anti-corruption.

classes.name: OrganisationalStructure
classes.description: A section describing the group’s organisational structure and important subsidiaries.

classes.name: PrincipalShareholder
classes.description: A person holding significant direct or indirect voting rights in the issuer, referenced in annex headings.

classes.name: PublicEndowment
classes.description: Public endowments referenced as providing guarantee funds or reserves with exclusive counterparties.

classes.name: PublicLimitedCompany
classes.description: A company organized as a public limited company (société anonyme), referenced as having a specified capital amount and registered office.

classes.name: PublicSectorInvestmentBank
classes.description: A type of company object described as a public sector investment bank facilitating access to financing and guarantees.

classes.name: RegulatedMarket
classes.description: A market for trading securities referenced as the context for admission to trading.

classes.name: Regulation
classes.description: A legal instrument governing filings and approvals under EU securities regulation referenced in the text.

classes.name: RelatedPartyTransaction
classes.description: Transactions between the issuer and related parties, referenced in annex headings.

classes.name: Remuneration
classes.description: Remuneration paid to people referred to in the French Monetary and Financial Code, approved by shareholders.

classes.name: RemunerationCommittee
classes.description: A committee referenced in corporate governance annexes for remuneration matters.

classes.name: RenewableEnergy
classes.description: Renewable energies referenced as the basis for long-term electricity supply guarantees.

classes.name: RiskFactorsSection
classes.description: A section of the universal registration document covering risk factors.

classes.name: SecuritiesAdmissionToTrading
classes.description: Admission of securities to trading on a regulated market, supported by the universal registration document and related securities notes.

classes.name: SecuritiesNote
classes.description: A document that, together with the universal registration document, enables an offer to the public or admission to trading.

classes.name: SecuritiesOffer
classes.description: An offer to the public of securities, for which the universal registration document may be used when completed by additional notes.

classes.name: StatutoryAuditor
classes.description: An auditor referenced in relation to reports on company and consolidated accounts and special auditors’ reports on agreements.

subclasses.name: SpecialAuditorsReport
subclasses.description: A special statutory auditors’ report on agreements referred to by the French Commercial Code.

classes.name: Subsidiary
classes.description: An entity considered as part of the group, referenced as important subsidiaries in the organisational structure.

classes.name: SummaryDocument
classes.description: A summary document that may be required alongside the universal registration document for certain securities transactions.

classes.name: TreasuryShares
classes.description: Shares held by the company itself, referenced in assumptions affecting dividend amounts.

classes.name: UniversalRegistrationDocument
classes.description: A universal registration document filed with a competent authority (AMF) and used as a base for securities offers or admissions to trading.

subclasses.name: AmendmentToUniversalRegistrationDocument
subclasses.description: An amendment to a universal registration document, filed with the competent authority and updating or replacing specific sections.
